arity3_stress_formula: arity 3 tests whether the two YBE paths agree visibly but differ by hidden fibre transport

cases.statement: for every n, the chosen quotient, block, and subquotient readouts assemble to a B_n-equivariant map R_n:X^n -> product_j T_{j,n}

cases.consequence: a braid acting trivially on every rack factor fixes every T_{j,n}-coordinate, hence fixes R_n(x), hence fixes x by injectivity

cases.statement: partial subquotients and crossing-closed blocks must be encoded as total marked factors, including their defined domain, incidence, and exit data

cases.consequence: two tuples can agree in every visible component while a braid in the visible kernel permutes hidden extension fibres
cases.statement: coordinatewise point-separating quotients, or separately dominated crossing-closed components, need not reconstruct the all-arity marked action tower

cases.consequence: the gluing theorem needs the off-diagonal transition data, not just detectors for the diagonal components
cases.statement: mixed-block crossings require explicit block incidence maps, transition groupoids, and fibre actions over the visible quotient states

cases.consequence: the YBE equation makes this hidden fibre action coherent, but it does not force it to be visible to the chosen product detectors

cases.consequence: visible product detectors dominate X if and only if this hidden-fibre action is trivial; injective reconstruction is the simple sufficient case where all H_t are singletons

extension_cocycle_formula: mixed-block extension fibres can carry a coherent omega_{z,z'} action invisible to diagonal detectors
hidden_fibre_formula: visible detectors dominate iff K_vis,n acts trivially on every H_t=F_n^-1(t)
partial_domain_formula: partial subquotient data must be totalized by recording domain, incidence, exits, and braid transport of definedness
product_kernel_formula: ker rho_product,n <= ker rho_X,n follows from equivariant injective reconstruction
reconstruction_formula: R_n:X^n -> product_j T_{j,n} is B_n-equivariant and injective for every n
total_quotient_formula: for genuine YBE quotients pi_j, injective pi:X->product_j Z_j implies injective pi^n:X^n->product_j Z_j^n
visible_kernel_formula: K_vis,n = intersection_j ker(B_n action on T_{j,n}) may still act on hidden fibres if R_n is not injective
